rationales.F01: Discomfort at the tip of the finger could be related to macrodactyly or lipomatosis of nerve.
rationales.F02: Finger enlargement since birth is a strong indicator of macrodactyly.
rationales.F03: Progressive growth of the finger is consistent with macrodactyly.
rationales.F04: Tingling at the fingertip could be related to lipomatosis of nerve.
rationales.F08: Finger enlargement is a key feature of macrodactyly.
rationales.F09: Tenderness throughout the enlargement could be related to lipomatosis of nerve.
rationales.F12: CT scan showing overgrowth of phalanges and soft tissue is consistent with both macrodactyly and lipomatosis of nerve.

frontier_selector.why: The evidence of progressive growth of the finger since birth and the lack of any findings arguing against Macrodactyly decided it.
